en: I really like this one, Susan. Do you?
cn: 我非常喜欢这一件，苏珊。你喜欢吗？

en: Turn around, Michelle. Let me see the back of it.
cn: 转过去，米歇尔。让我看看后面。

en: I like it a lot. It fits well. It doesn't need any alterations.
We must have bought the right size.
cn: 它不需要任何修改。我们一定买对了尺码。

en: I like the color. She looks good in blue.
cn: 我喜欢这颜色。她穿蓝色好看。

en: I like blue, too, Daddy.
Try on the skirt and blouse outfit, Michelle.
cn: 试试裙子和衬衫那套，米歇尔——

en: The one that Daddy wanted you to wear.
Okay.
Michelle has been a different kid since we've been married.
cn: 我们结婚以来，米歇尔就像变了个人。

en: She's never been happier.
And I've never been happier, Harry.
cn: 我也从没这么开心过，哈里。

en: I love her very much.
cn: 我非常爱她。她是个快乐。

en: She's been a joy.
We're very lucky, the three of us.
And becoming part of the Stewart family, too.
cn: 而且也成为斯图尔特家的一员。

en: We couldn't ask for anything more, could we?
cn: 我们不能再奢求什么了，对吧？

en: Well...
Could we ask for anything more?
cn: 嗯……？我们还能再奢求什么？

en: No, we...
How do you like it, Daddy?
It's my favorite outfit.
It's good for every day.
cn: 适合每天穿。上学也合适，米歇尔。

en: It will be good for school, Michelle.
I like it, too. I always like a skirt circle like this.
cn: 我也喜欢。我一直喜欢这种飘逸的裙子。

en: Do you want to see the winter jacket on me, Susan?
cn: 你想看我穿冬天的夹克吗，苏珊？

en: Yes, I do.
Change back into your jeans
cn: 是的，我想。换回你的牛仔裤，

en: and put on the new winter jacket we bought today.
cn: 然后穿上我们今天买的新冬装夹克。

en: Okay.
What did you mean by, well...
You had something on your mind when I said
cn: 你说我们不能再奢求什么时，

en: we couldn't ask for anything more.
Is everything all right?
Everything is fine, Michelle.
Let's take a look at the winter jacket.
cn: 我们看看冬装夹克吧。过来，亲爱的。

en: Come on over here, honey.
It's kind of warm.
It is. That's why we bought it for you.
cn: 是的。所以我们要买给你。

en: This will be a perfect jacket for the winter time
cn: 这会是一件完美的冬天夹克，

en: when it's very cold out.
But it's kind of small also.
cn: 但有点小。我们一定买错了尺码。

en: We must have bought the wrong size.
Looks like we should have bought a bigger one.
cn: 看来我们该买大一号的。

en: I guess we'll have to exchange it, too.
I'm sure the store has others.
I look silly. It is too small.
You're growing so fast, Michelle.
Can I take it off? I'm hot.
Sure.
Put it back in your room and we'll hang everything up later.
cn: 当然。把它放回你房间，我们一会儿再挂起来。

en: Are you going to tell me what's on your mind, Harry?
cn: 嗯，你要告诉我你在想什么吗，哈里？

en: I have been offered a job
with a major accounting company in Los Angeles.
cn: 他在洛杉矶有个大玩具买家，

en: I have been offered a job
with a major accounting company in Los Angeles.
Los Angeles?
That's a big decision.
cn: 洛杉矶？这是个重大决定。

en: I know.
It will also affect you and your job
cn: 我知道。如果我们决定去，也会影响你和你的工作。

en: if we decide to go.
Well, it sure will.
But first, tell me about the job, Harry.
cn: 哇！确实会。但先告诉我工作的事，哈里。

en: If it's a good one, then we'll make it work for us.
cn: 如果是好工作，那我们就想办法。

en: I have a client in the garment business on 7th Avenue.
I do his taxes every year.
He has a big sales office in Los Angeles,
cn: 他在洛杉矶有个大销售办事处，

en: and the company in Los Angeles
that does his major accounting work
cn: 给他做主要会计工作的公司

en: is looking for an executive,
cn: 正在找一位高管。他推荐了我。

en: and he recommended me.
That's wonderful, Harry.
Yes, but it would mean that we'd have to move to L.A.
cn: 是的，但那意味着我们得搬到洛杉矶。

en: What about the salary?
The real discussion comes tomorrow.
Susan, I plan to make any decisions
cn: 苏珊，我不打算做任何决定，

en: until I have a chance to talk with you about it.
I understand, Harry.
And I don't have to make a quick decision.
cn: 而且我不需要急着做决定。

en: They know that I'm married and that I have a family.
cn: 他们知道我已婚，有家庭。

en: Well, there's a lot to think about.
If it's a good job,
then I've got to do some thinking
about my career opportunities in Los Angeles.
cn: 我在洛杉矶的职业机会。

en: Is everything okay?
Yes, honey.
Are you ready for lunch with your grandpa?
cn: 你准备好和爷爷吃午饭了吗？

en: Oh, hi, grandpa.
Yes, of course I am, but my mind isn't.
cn: 哦！嗨，爷爷。是的，当然，但我心不在焉。

en: What's the matter, Susan?
A real dilemma.
Does it have anything to do with you and Harry?
Yes, but I don't know where to start.
cn: 是的，但我不知道从何说起。

en: Maybe I can help.
cn: 也许我能帮上忙。告诉我，苏珊。

en: Tell me what it is, Susan.
Yes, grandpa.
Please sit down.
Oh.
Harry has been offered a job in Los Angeles.
cn: 哦！哈里得到了一份洛杉矶的工作。

en: Well, this is something to think about.
There are so many things to consider.
cn: 有那么多事情要考虑。还有米歇尔。

en: There's Michelle.
I wonder if a move would be a bad thing for her.
cn: 我想知道搬家对她是不是坏事。还有我的工作。

en: And my job.
I don't know if I can get a good job in Los Angeles.
cn: 我不知道在洛杉矶能否找到好工作。

en: And what about our family?
Can I tell you what I think?
cn: 我能告诉你我的想法吗？

en: Tell me.
I think that you're very successful
and that you have a fantastic reputation in the toy industry.
cn: 而且你在玩具行业名声很好。

en: I think you could talk to Mr. Marchetta.
cn: 我觉得你可以和马凯塔先生谈谈，

en: And I think he could help you find a real good job
cn: 他能帮你在洛杉矶找一份真正的好工作。

en: in Los Angeles.
He was very helpful to me, remember?
I suppose I could call him.
cn: 我想我可以给他打电话。

en: But I'm not so sure that I want to leave New York,
cn: 但我不太确定我想离开纽约，

en: you and the rest of our family.
cn: 离开你和我们家其他人。

en: Well, I'm not going to kid you, Susan.
You know we'd all miss you.
But this should be your decision.
It's something that only you and Harry can work out.
cn: 这是只有你和哈里才能解决的事。

en: If moving to LA is in Harry's best interest,
cn: 如果搬到洛杉矶对哈里最有利，

en: I have to do what I can do to support him.
In every marriage, sacrifices have to be made
by one partner from time to time.
cn: 一方时不时得做出牺牲。

en: And what about Michelle?
Well, what do you think?
I think Michelle is better off staying where she is.
What does she think?
I don't know for sure.
Well, you'll have to ask her.
I think I'm going to have a talk with Mr. Marchetta
and get his feelings about my leaving
cn: 他对我的离开有什么感觉。

en: and about helping me find a job in Los Angeles.
cn: 还有帮我在洛杉矶找工作。

en: Good idea.
I'll call him right now, no point in delaying.
cn: 我现在就给他打电话。没必要拖延。

en: Thanks, Grandpa.
Harry, it's the perfect job for you.
cn: 哈里，这是最适合你的工作。你会喜欢的。

en: You'll love it.
It's a big decision for me, Bill.
cn: 对我来说是个大决定，比尔。

en: And I have to discuss it with my wife.
I don't know if it's right for her.
cn: 我不知道对她是否合适。

en: She'll love it.
It's a once in a lifetime offer, Harry.
cn: 她会喜欢的。这是一生一次的机会，哈里。

en: OK.
Tell it to me again.
Oh, the company is Kraft and Kraft,
cn: 公司是克拉夫特和克拉夫特，

en: the biggest accounting company in the country.
I know the company well.
It's big.
The biggest.
Yeah, yeah, the biggest.
When do I have to let you know?
cn: 是啊，是啊。最大的。我什么时候要给你答复？

en: I'll talk it over, think it over.
cn: 商量一下。考虑一下。本周末前给我答复。

en: Let me know by the end of the week.
When would we have to move?
As soon as possible.
I also have my daughter to consider.
I don't want to interrupt her school year.
Let me know by the end of the week.
It's a great opportunity for you, Harry, believe me.
cn: 这对你是个大好机会，哈里。

en: I know.
Kraft and Kraft is the biggest in the country.
cn: 克拉夫特和克拉夫特是全国最大的。

en: Yeah, I know.
The biggest.
I think Michelle is asleep now.
Let's talk.
I met with Bill York today.
And I talked with Mr. Marchetta.
Did York make the offer?
Yep, he asked me if I want the job.
cn: 嗯。他问我要不要这份工作。

en: That's exciting, Harry.
cn: 那真令人激动，哈里。什么工作？

en: What was it?
A vice presidency with the biggest accounting
company in the country, Kraft and Kraft.
Aren't you excited about that?
Mm-hmm, sure I am, but there's so much more to consider.
I talked to Mr. Marchetta.
What did he say?
cn: 他说什么？你告诉他我的事了吗？

en: Did you tell him about me?
cn: 你何不告诉我们你今天的事。

en: Of course, Harry.
I want what's best for you.
cn: 当然，哈里。我希望你得到最好的，

en: And I think I can get a good job through Mr. Marchetta
cn: 而且我觉得我能找到好工作，

en: in Los Angeles also.
cn: 我怎么能在洛杉矶生活，

en: You're kidding.
No, I'm not kidding.
I talked with him, and he understands completely.
cn: 我和他谈过，他完全理解。

en: He has a major toy buyer in Los Angeles,
and he's pretty sure that I can get a good job there.
cn: 他相当确定我能在那里找到好工作。

en: Unbelievable.
But I think we should talk to Michelle about all of this.
cn: 但我觉得我们应该和米歇尔谈谈这些。

en: You're right.
We'll talk to her about it.
And how do you feel about taking the job in Los Angeles?
cn: 那对于接受洛杉矶的工作，你觉得怎么样？

en: How should I feel?
It's the biggest company in the country.
cn: 我真的想为全国最大的公司工作吗？

en: Well, then you feel good about taking it.
Well, I feel fine about it.
cn: 嗯……我觉得挺好。为什么不呢？

en: Why shouldn't I?
I love my school.
I have so many good friends there now.
cn: 我爱我的学校。我现在有那么多好朋友。

en: I wouldn't miss a day, even if I were really sick.
cn: 就算我真病了也不愿缺课一天。

en: Come and sit down for a minute, Michelle.
I'd like to talk to you about something, something important.
What's wrong, Susan?
Oh, there's nothing wrong, Michelle.
But your daddy and I are talking about something
cn: 但你爸爸和我正在谈一件事，

en: that I'd like your opinion about.
I know.
I heard you talking about it the other night
cn: 我知道。我听到你们谈过了，

en: when I was trying out my new clothes.
cn: 那天晚上我试新衣服的时候。

en: It's about moving to Los Angeles.
You're right.
How do you feel about it?
cn: 你说得对。你觉得怎么样？

en: Well, I really wouldn't want to move.
cn: 嗯，我真的不想搬家，但是……

en: But if you and daddy wanted to, I
guess you know what's best for the family and for me.
cn: 我想你们最清楚什么对家庭和我最好。

en: That's very considerate of you, Michelle.
But what about your friends?
I'd miss them a lot.
But I know what it feels like to miss someone.
cn: 但我知道想念一个人是什么感觉。

en: Honey, we don't have to move if you're not
going to be happy about it.
Does daddy want to move?
I think so.
He's going to tell us tonight about the job offer.
cn: 我想是的。他今晚会告诉我们工作的事。

en: How was everybody's day today?
cn: 嗯，大家今天过得怎么样？

en: Michelle was chosen to do the school poster
for the play this year.
cn: 做今年学校话剧的海报。

en: Congratulations, Michelle.
That's something.
And how was your day, Susan?
I see you're in a good mood.
Why don't you tell us about your day?
cn: 好。现在，告诉我们你和约克先生的谈话。

en: I met with Bill York.
It's OK to talk about it, Harry.
Michelle knows all about it.
Really?
Really, Harry.
Michelle and I have all kinds of feelings
cn: 米歇尔和我对离开纽约、家人和朋友

en: about leaving New York, the family and friends.
But if you think you should take the job, we're behind you.
cn: 但如果你觉得应该接受这份工作，我们支持你。

en: What about Michelle's school?
We'll move after the school turn.
What about her new friends?
I'll make new friends, wherever we are,
cn: 只要我们在一起，无论去哪我都会交到新朋友。

en: as long as we're together.
cn: 作为长作为我们是一起

en: We're a family, Harry.
Whatever you think is right for you is right for us.
cn: 无论你觉得什么对你好，对我们也都好。

en: I am so touched.
The two of you are really something.
cn: 我太感动了。你们俩真是了不起。

en: We love you, daddy.
OK.
Now, tell us about your talk with Mr. York.
cn: 现在告诉us关于你的谈话和Mr.York.

en: Did you take the job?
Nope.
What?
No?
You didn't take it?
No, I did not take the job.
But daddy, I thought...
Harry, you didn't turn it down because of me.
Or me.
No.
No, I turned it down because of me.
cn: 不，不。我是因为我自己拒绝的。

en: How's that?
Well, I began to think about you and about Michelle.
cn: 嗯，我开始想你、想米歇尔，

en: And then I asked myself, do I really
want to work for the biggest company in the country?
cn: 想要去工作为了这biggest公司在这country?

en: And I don't.
I went into business for myself because I
like being my own boss.
cn: 是因为我喜欢自己当老板。

en: I run my own company.
cn: 我经营自己的公司。我是小池塘里的大鱼。

en: I'm a big fish in a little pond.
cn: 我不太确定我想成为大池塘里的小鱼。

en: I'm not really sure I want to be a little fish in a big pond.
cn: 我是不真当然我想要去是一个littlefish在一个大pond.

en: Oh, daddy, does that mean we don't have to move?
cn: 哦，爸爸，那是说我们不用搬了？

en: That's right, sweetheart.
Are you sure?
I couldn't be more sure, Susan.
I'm glad if you are, Harry.
cn: 你确定我就高兴了，哈里。

en: Besides, how could I live in Los Angeles
when all my favorite people live here?
cn: 当所有我最喜欢的人都在这里？

en: Your favorite people?
Who's that?
The Stewart family, of course.
